cortex.classification: Successful count-based statistical reproduction, not independent biological replication or raw-read realignment

marker_QC.qualification: Observed source counts for Ddx3y, Uty, Kdm5d and Xist in every cortex animal. A: normalized expression with condition labels; no animals are omitted. B: Xist versus the sum of three Y-linked markers, without classification or an exposure-effect test. All four PBS animals have zero raw counts for each Y marker, while other conditions contain heterogeneous values. These genes also rank at the top of the original Wald FDR tables but shrink toward zero with apeglm. This is a diagnostic flag for independently verifying sample sex, identity and other technical explanations. Sex cannot be assigned or a confounder established from this plot alone. The original group-only model is preserved.

hypothalamus.classification: Partial methodological sensitivity only; exact original RUVg fit not recoverable
not_exact_reason: The original 5000 empirical negative-control gene IDs were not recovered; the RUVg factor count k was not stated.
The supplement describes limma/edgeR and negative-binomial testing without complete reproducible R commands.
Negative-control selection text pairs not significantly changed genes with FDR <0.05, leaving the intended rule ambiguous.
No original gene-level DE table was recovered; only published count benchmarks could be read.
Main Figure 2 logCPM >1 differs from supplement CPM >2; this sensitivity explicitly declares its own abundance rule.
hypothalamus.publication_caption_issue: Supplement Figure S9 caption C calls the tissue muscle, but panel C is visibly labeled Hypothalamus (N=11): PM 12 specific +5 shared; HFD 756 specific +5 shared.
